SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'CY' ELSE 'PY' END AS per,
 s.store_id<900 AS is_store, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl,
 min(f.sale_date) AS mind, max(f.sale_date) AS maxd, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS minload, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS maxload,
 sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonposq
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH sl AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'CY' ELSE 'PY' END per, s.store_id,
  sum(f.net_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) excl_staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') GROUP BY 1,2),
rt AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'CY' ELSE 'PY' END per, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN 'CY' ELSE 'PY' END per, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 AND (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24') GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT sl.store_id, sl.per, sl.gross_all, sl.excl_staff, rt.ret, rp.nsbr, rp.rn, rp.ns, rp.days
FROM sl LEFT JOIN rt USING(per,store_id) LEFT JOIN rp USING(per,store_id) ORDER BY sl.store_id, sl.per

SELECT 'cal' AS k, fiscal_period_label AS a, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) AS b, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) AS c, NULL AS d, NULL AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label IN ('FY2026/27 P04','FY2025/26 P04')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orph', 'sales_rows_no_store', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'wk', CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR), CAST(d.fiscal_year AS VARCHAR)||' w'||CAST(d.fiscal_week AS VARCHAR), CAST(round(sum(f.net_amount)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id IN (127,109,105,136) AND (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-06' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-30' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
GROUP BY s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH cy AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label='FY2026/27 P04'),
py AS (SELECT period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label='FY2025/26 P04'),
st AS (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, min(open_date) od, max(close_date) cd FROM dim_store WHERE store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 GROUP BY store_id),
full_days AS (
 SELECT r.store_id,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN cy.s AND cy.e AND r.net_sales_before_returns>0 THEN r.business_date END) cy_days,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN py.s AND py.e AND r.net_sales_before_returns>0 THEN r.business_date END) py_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, cy, py WHERE r.store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 GROUP BY r.store_id),
closed AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.store_id FROM ref_store_closure c, cy, py WHERE (c.closure_start_date<=cy.e AND c.closure_end_date>=cy.s) OR (c.closure_start_date<=py.e AND c.closure_end_date>=py.s)),
lfl AS (
 SELECT st.store_id FROM st, cy, full_days fd
 WHERE st.store_id=fd.store_id AND fd.cy_days=28 AND fd.py_days=28
  AND (st.od IS NULL OR st.od <= cy.s - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND st.cd IS NULL
  AND st.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM closed)),
agg AS (
 SELECT r.store_id,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN cy.s AND cy.e THEN r.net_sales END) cy_ns,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN py.s AND py.e THEN r.net_sales END) py_ns,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-04' AND DATE '2025-08-31' THEN r.net_sales END) py364_ns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, cy, py WHERE r.store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 GROUP BY r.store_id)
SELECT 'A main LFL' k, count(*) n_st, sum(cy_ns) cy, sum(py_ns) py, round(100*(sum(cy_ns)/sum(py_ns)-1),3) g FROM agg WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl)
UNION ALL SELECT 'B excl 136,137', count(*), sum(cy_ns), sum(py_ns), round(100*(sum(cy_ns)/sum(py_ns)-1),3) FROM agg WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND store_id NOT IN (136,137)
UNION ALL SELECT 'C excl Kuopio 125', count(*), sum(cy_ns), sum(py_ns), round(100*(sum(cy_ns)/sum(py_ns)-1),3) FROM agg WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl) AND store_id<>125
UNION ALL SELECT 'E py 364d shift', count(*), sum(cy_ns), sum(py364_ns), round(100*(sum(cy_ns)/sum(py364_ns)-1),3) FROM agg WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl)
UNION ALL SELECT 'F all stores', count(*), sum(cy_ns), sum(py_ns), round(100*(sum(cy_ns)/sum(py_ns)-1),3) FROM agg
UNION ALL SELECT 'excluded: '||string_agg(CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ','), 0,0,0,0 FROM agg WHERE store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl)

SELECT 'returns' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_sl, sum(CASE WHEN refund_net<=0 OR quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad, min(return_date) mn, max(return_date) mx
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ret_vs_sale', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<s.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN s.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'trading', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), sum(CASE WHEN is_public_holiday THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), NULL, min(calendar_date), max(calendar_date)
FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24'

WITH cy AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label = 'FY2026/27 P04'),
py AS (SELECT period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period_label = 'FY2025/26 P04'),
st AS (SELECT store_id, min(open_date) AS od, max(close_date) AS cd FROM dim_store WHERE store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 GROUP BY store_id),
agg AS (
  SELECT r.store_id,
    count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN cy.s AND cy.e AND r.net_sales_before_returns > 0 THEN r.business_date END) AS cy_days,
    count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN py.s AND py.e AND r.net_sales_before_returns > 0 THEN r.business_date END) AS py_days,
    sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN cy.s AND cy.e THEN r.net_sales END) AS cy_ns,
    sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN py.s AND py.e THEN r.net_sales END) AS py_ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r, cy, py WHERE r.store_id BETWEEN 100 AND 899 GROUP BY r.store_id),
closed AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.store_id FROM ref_store_closure c, cy, py
  WHERE (c.closure_start_date <= cy.e AND c.closure_end_date >= cy.s) OR (c.closure_start_date <= py.e AND c.closure_end_date >= py.s))
SELECT cy.fiscal_year, cy.fiscal_period, round(100 * (sum(a.cy_ns) / sum(a.py_ns) - 1), 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM agg a JOIN st USING (store_id), cy
WHERE a.cy_days = 28 AND a.py_days = 28 AND st.cd IS NULL
  AND (st.od IS NULL OR st.od <= cy.s - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
  AND a.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM closed)
GROUP BY cy.fiscal_year, cy.fiscal_period
